lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Night one. The dispatch floor hums like a held breath — a wall of screens, a hundred blinking lines, and the quiet certainty that somewhere out there, someone is about to need you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Rule one is stenciled right on the console: not every voice on this frequency wants saving. The system will help you tell the difference. By the end, you'll wonder if it helps a little too much.

beats.prompt: First night. What do you tell yourself?

choices.label: I'm here to help all of them.
Learn the protocol. Trust the system.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The board lights up. Your first line is waiting. Whatever you walked in believing, the city is about to start testing it — one call at a time.
